name: React Bits Components
summary: Index of React Bits' free animated React components — text effects, backgrounds, cards and micro-interactions — with live demos.
description: Browses the free React Bits library grouped into UI Components, Animations, Backgrounds, Text Animations and Micro Interactions, each item with a live demo. Components ship in four variants (JavaScript or TypeScript, with plain CSS or Tailwind) and install by copying the source or through the jsrepo and shadcn CLIs.
contains: categorized: UI Components, Animations, Backgrounds, Text Animations, Micro Interactions
each component in four variants: JS/TS × CSS/Tailwind
installs via jsrepo or the shadcn CLI from the reactbits.dev registry (820 catalogued registry items)
everything on the page is free; React Bits Pro is a separate paid library
